intro: How Raypx handles conversations, account information and device preferences.

local.title: Device-local data
local.body: Unsent conversation drafts and unconfirmed-send receipts stay on this device, scoped to the server, account, Space and conversation. Theme, language and diagnostics preferences also stay on the device.
local.detail: Restoring a draft never sends it. Clearing device storage does not delete conversation records already stored by the server.

account.title: Account information
account.body: Creating an account stores your email address, display name and password hash. Sign-in records can include timestamps, an IP address and browser information to support authentication and session management.
account.detail: Verification and password-reset emails use the deployment's configured mail service. That service receives the recipient address and the message needed to deliver the email.

remote.title: Conversations and model replies
remote.body: Agents, conversations, messages and Run records are stored in the deployment’s PostgreSQL database. The backend checks Space membership before access and sends conversation context to the configured model provider when you request a reply.
remote.detail: This phase has no Agent tools or computer access. The earlier device execution runtime remains in the repository; it is separate from the Agents conversation workspace.

storage.title: Cookies and device storage
storage.body: Authentication uses session cookies. Theme and language preferences use cookies and device storage so they can be restored before the page renders. Diagnostics choices are also stored on the device.
storage.detail: Conversation drafts use device storage. Signing out preserves device preferences. Clearing browser storage does not delete records already held by a deployment.

diagnostics.title: Optional diagnostics
diagnostics.body: Usage statistics and error reports are separate choices, both off by default. If configured for the deployment and enabled by you, diagnostics are sent to PostHog. Statistics can associate feature usage with your internal account ID; error reports are anonymous when statistics are off.
diagnostics.detail: Diagnostics exclude session content, files, local paths, terminal output and credentials. Error reports use safe error codes and application code locations. Session replay and automatic interaction capture are disabled. Turning diagnostics off stops new collection; it does not delete reports already delivered.

providers.title: Service providers
providers.body: The operator of your Raypx deployment configures its hosting, database, email, optional object storage and analytics services. The Agent or model provider you run or configure processes the inputs you send to it under its own data terms.
providers.detail: Which providers receive data depends on the deployment and your choices. Review their privacy information before sending project context or other sensitive content to them.

controls.title: Your choices and retention
controls.body: Manage theme, language and diagnostics in Settings. Open Account to review and revoke sign-in sessions or manage security methods.
controls.detail: Signing out or revoking access does not erase stored history. Server retention, backups and deletion are managed by the operator of the deployment you use. Contact that operator about data access, deletion or privacy questions.
